name: Creeping Cone Swarm

defensiveAbilities.name: Swarm Mind
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.

defensiveAbilities.name: Blight Burst
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The creeping cone swarm is reduced to fewer than half its Hit Points or is reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect A 15ft Emanation of acid explodes from the creeping cone swarm. Creatures in the area take 3d12 Acid Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save). Non-blight bonded creatures damaged by this effect are exposed to Ayrzul's Blight.

offensiveAbilities.name: Jagged Scales
offensiveAbilities.description: The creeping cones shake off a barrage of jagged, stony scales. Each creature in a 10ft Burst within 30 feet of the swarm takes (2d12+7) Slashing Damage damage (Basic DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Pummeling Lurches
offensiveAbilities.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 6d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 29 Fortitude Saving Throw save). A creature that fails its save falls Prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Putrid Spores
offensiveAbilities.description:
30 feet.

A creature entering the aura must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Sickened 1 until the end of its turn (Sickened 2 on a critical failure).

While within the aura, an affected creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.
